text:
maria (support): FYI customer 'HorizonHealth' hitting huge queue backlog in ap-south-1, asking for short burst capacity to avoid demo failure this afternoon.

maria (support): queue length spiked from ~30 -> 220 concurrent requests in 6m, admission-control is rejecting new requests with 429s.

maria (support): request: temporary GPU quota bump x3 (from 8->24 GPUs) for 4 hours, starting now if possible. customer says they're willing to pay overage.

ashok (eng-sre): digging in. seeing large KV-cache miss rate and egress throttling to eu-west1 for feature lookups, causing backpressure on serving nodes. logs: `admission:reject rate=0.78 token=429 reason=region_capacity_ap-south-1`

ashok (eng-sre): autoscaler trying to add nodes but hitting AZ soft-limits; cloud reports 'InsufficientInstanceCapacity' in ap-south-1c.

autoscale-bot: autoscaler event: scale_up_attempt failed (reason: capacity), attempted 6 -> 12 pods.

maria (support): @ashok can we do a manual override on admission-control to temporarily relax queue depth and allow CPU-fallback lanes for non-latency-critical requests?

ashok (eng-sre): we can open an admission-control exception to allow extra pods (best-effort) but hardware shortage means those pods may land in ap-south-2 which has higher egress cost. alternative: route demo traffic to eu-west1 where capacity is free, but adds 80-120ms RTT.

sam (sales): customer is in a sales-critical live demo in 2 hours. they'd prefer AP region despite latency. they've pre-authorized overage up to $3k for the window.

eva (customer-success): confirm they accept increased cost and only need the bump for 3 hours max. also want a note about graceful fallback if we can't fully satisfy GPUs.

ashok (eng-sre): propose compromise: 12 GPU soft-burst (1.5x) for 3 hours, plus set admission-control policy to allow CPU-fallback for requests flagged `demo=false` to reduce pressure. need billing OK.

maria (support): @sam can you confirm billing authorization and roll this into a support invoice?

sam (sales): confirmed. approve up to $2k. will add cust consent in the ticket.

oncall-bot: oncall assigned: ashok -> 1767213000.

ashok (eng-sre): manual override request filed: `override-id: OV-2026-1123`, scope: ap-south-1, GPUs +12, duration 3h, admission-change: cpu-fallback=true for tagged requests. applying now.

autoscale-bot: override applied (OV-2026-1123). new target pods: 14 (was 8).

maria (support): running smoke checks. initial traffic routed, 200 OKs returning but median p99 token latency increased 35%.

eva (customer-success): customer reports demo proceeding, minor sluggishness but acceptable. :thumbsup:

ashok (eng-sre): monitoring queue. backlog dropping from 220 -> 40 over 12 minutes. will keep override but prepare rollback if cloud capacity changes.

maria (support): closing loop: I'll open billing change request and update ticket with OV-2026-1123 and customer signed consent.

sam (sales): pls add note: cost center: sales-trials, promo code applied? none. invoice to be sent to finance.

ashok (eng-sre): once demo ends, I'll revert admission settings and scale down to original capacity. expected rollback time 10-15m after end.

maria (support): thanks everyone. filing post-incident note to eng-sre ops channel with timelines and recommended permanent mitigations: - pre-warm capacity in AP for large demos - add region-routing policy to failover to eu-west with opt-in - surface egress cost estimate in demo runbook.

oncall-bot: ticket OV-2026-1123 scheduled to auto-expire at 1767223145 (3h after start).

maria (support): thread closed for now, will reopen if regressions.
